Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
The latest wording of Pulled Fangs, according to the white wolf website, is
this:
"Only usable at the end of a round of combat in which this minion inflicted
more damage at close range than the opposing vampire. Not usable by a <minion
being burned or going into torpor>.
Put this card on the opposing vampire, and this minion inflicts 1 point of
damage. The victim cannot hunt until this card is removed. Any vampire(s)
may burn this card with two +1 stealth actions. If the victim must hunt
and cannot, he or she goes into torpor. A vampire can have only 1 Pulled
Fangs."

If I asked this as a question, LSJ would say "Yes. Card Text".

So here's the thing:
An Imbued on his way to the incapacitated region is not being burned or
going into torpor.
So, if an Imbued runs out of life, and is becoming incapacitated, but he
hit you for more damage, he can pull your fangs on his way down!

That's odd. But apparently true.
